lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Giovanna de Fátima | Lesson 9 -- Can You Repeat That?
lesson.grammar_point: can / cannot for ability, permission and polite requests

listenings.text: This machine can cut forty meters in one day. It can work in wet ground, but it cannot work in rock. In the tunnel we can use two machines together. We cannot start before seven, because of the noise rule. If you have a question, you can call me at any time.

I can read English very well. I can write an e-mail without help. But I cannot understand people on the phone, because they speak very fast. So I always say the same thing: can you speak slowly, please? And people can do that. It is not a problem.

extra_audio.text: Giovanna is in a video meeting. She cannot understand one sentence. She says: can you repeat that, please. The other person speaks slowly. Now she understands everything.
